nodes.speaker: Seila
nodes.text: Gladias is detained. The board is mine now. Three houses, three pairs. I don't win by authority — I win by weight.

nodes.speaker: Telroy
nodes.text: Money. Ledgers show Lektor funds routed via Jump accounts. Which pair proves the bagman?

nodes.speaker: Seila
nodes.text: Rumors weigh nothing. Read the summaries again.

nodes.speaker: Balme
nodes.text: Blood. The duel roster, the Sergeants' oath. Who ordered the Northshore stand-down?

nodes.speaker: Seila
nodes.text: Gossip is air. Pairs, not vibes.

nodes.speaker: Lectoby
nodes.text: Law. The statute, the sealed minute. What makes the firing legal?

nodes.speaker: Seila
nodes.text: Hope isn't evidence. One more look.

nodes.speaker: Lily
nodes.text: Mom. I carried the messages. Weight mine high and finish it fast — or protect me and find the last link yourself?

choices.label: Weight Lily high (she radicalizes toward the leak)
Protect Lily, close with Balme's duel evidence

clues.title: Sealed minute
clues.summary: Parliament blocked as head — Courts may fire
